sections.label: Mental well-being workplace initiatives
sections.summary: The Government has worked with partners to roll out tools and resources encouraging companies to adopt mental well-being initiatives, including the 2020 Tripartite Advisory.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: The Government has been working with our partners to roll out tools and resources to encourage companies to adopt mental well-being initiatives, for instance, the Tripartite Advisory on mental well-being at workplaces was released in 2020.

sections.label: iWorkHealth survey launch
sections.summary: In 2021, iWorkHealth was launched as a free, company-administered survey to help employers identify workplace stressors and improvement areas.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: In 2021, we launched iWorkHealth, a free, company-administered survey to help employers identify workplace stressors and improvement areas.

sections.label: Employee dissatisfaction survey finding
sections.summary: NTUC's 2021 Special Report on Mental Wellness at the Workplace found 54% of employees were not satisfied with their companies' mental well-being initiatives.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Based on NTUC’s 2021 Special Report on Mental Wellness at the Workplace, 54% of employees were not satisfied with their companies' mental well-being initiatives.

sections.label: Employer Support Grant pilot
sections.summary: NCSS is currently piloting an Employer Support Grant to incentivise employers to implement workplace adjustments for employees with mental health conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: The National Council of Social Service (NCSS) is currently piloting an Employer Support Grant to incentivise employers to implement workplace adjustments for their employees with mental health conditions.

sections.label: Enshrining fair employment guidelines
sections.summary: The Government has decided to enshrine the Tripartite Guidelines on Fair Employment Practices in law.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: As announced recently, we have decided to take the very significant step of enshrining the Tripartite Guidelines on Fair Employment Practices in law.

sections.label: Reviewing $20,000 exemption bar
sections.summary: The $20,000 exemption bar is not carved in stone and will be reviewed from time to time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Just like the qualifying salaries, this $20,000 exemption bar is also not carved in stone and we will review it from time to time.

sections.label: COMPASS in EP application process
sections.summary: COMPASS is an additional stage in the EP application process and will not loosen the current EP framework.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: COMPASS is an additional stage in the entire EP application process.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: So, in no way will it loosen our current EP framework.

sections.label: Strengthening gaming enforcement process
sections.summary: Enforcement process for gaming will be strengthened.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As far as the gaming itself is concerned, we will strengthen our enforcement process.

sections.label: Employers falsely declaring EP information
sections.summary: Employers found to have falsely declared information to get an EP application approved will not be spared.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Having said that, it is not our intention, but we will not hesitate to take employers to task if they are found to have falsely declared information to get the EP application approved.

sections.label: Top-tier university qualifications as measure
sections.summary: Qualifications from top-tier universities remain a fairly useful standardised measure of a candidate's quality and competency levels.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Today, qualifications from the top-tier universities remain a fairly useful standardised measure of a candidate's quality and competency levels.

sections.label: EP criteria and professional certifications
sections.summary: A candidate without a degree-equivalent qualification can qualify for the EP by scoring well on other criteria, and MOM will work with sector agencies to recognise industry-regarded professional certifications.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As a candidate without a degree-equivalent qualification can still qualify for the EP if the application scores well on the other criteria.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: MOM will work with other sector agencies to recognise professional certifications that are well regarded by the industry.

sections.label: Expert Investment Council and LRIS
sections.summary: The question asks whether the Expert Investment Council has completed its work and whether the Government still intends to roll out the LRIS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: My question is whether or not the Expert Investment Council has completed its work and whether the Government still intends to roll out the LRIS.

sections.label: Evaluation amid global volatility
sections.summary: The Member is reassured that evaluation continues, given a black swan event and volatility from the Russia-Ukraine crisis.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Just to reassure the Member, we are indeed still evaluating.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: There has been a black swan event that has happened within the last two-and-a-half years and, given the current volatility and the crisis in Russia and Ukraine, if we had taken on certain positions just prior to this in, say, 2019 and so on, we would have been quite badly affected.

sections.label: No EP quota decided
sections.summary: No quota or number has been decided for the EP framework, as EP holders are meant to be top-tier work pass holders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: I will take the first question and Senior Minister of State Koh will take the second point.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We have not, in our considerations, decided on setting a quota or number for the EP framework because EP holders are meant to be the top-tier in terms of all our work pass holders.

sections.label: No fixed EP target
sections.summary: There is no aspirational target for a fixed number of EP holders, and the $20,000 exemption is not carved in stone.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The long answer to his question is that we do not have an aspirational target in terms of a fixed number of EP holders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Having said that, notwithstanding, the criteria being where they are today, as I have shared earlier to the Member of Parliament Mr Desmond Choo's point about setting this $20,000 exemption, it is not carved in stone.

sections.label: PWM coverage and COMPASS criteria
sections.summary: About 6% of full-time low-wage workers will still not be covered by PWM by 2023, and COMPASS uses data analytics for a nuanced framework.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: If not, what is the policy intent of this criterion?

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: And lastly, on the wages of low-wage workers, I know that by 2023 about 6% of full-time, low-wage workers will still not be covered by the PWM.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Who are most of the workers in this group and does MOM intend to eventually extend PWM to all of them so that every Singaporean would be able to receive a decent minimum wage on their work?

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: COMPASS has actually taken into consideration the many months of data analytics, in terms of the hiring patterns, based on diversity, based on qualifications, salaries and also the concentration of PMETs within the firm, to come up with a fairly nuanced framework.

sections.label: Nationality diversity for risk
sections.summary: The nationality diversity consideration resulted from diversifying risk in dependency on the source of talent itself.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The nationality diversity consideration was also the result of making sure that we diversify our risk in terms of our dependency on the source of talent itself.

sections.label: Most earning $1,400 and above
sections.summary: For the majority of them, they are already earning $1,400 and above.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Actually, for the majority of them, they are already earning $1,400 and above.

sections.label: Small businesses and micro-SMEs
sections.summary: Many are small businesses with fewer than 10 persons, mostly micro-SMEs in heartlands such as mom-and-pop shops.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: In our case, we found that many of them are actually small businesses with less than 10 persons and most of these are actually micro-SMEs in your heartlands, typically your mom-and-pop shops.

sections.label: Wage growth and moral suasion
sections.summary: Wage growth of fifty-plus to eighty-plus percent for lower-wage workers sets labour market competition and benchmarks for merchants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: These are ways in which I think there is moral suasion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But overall, if you look at where we are in terms of the kind of wage growth that you are expecting for the other PWMs shared here, ranging from fifty-plus percent to eighty-plus percent wage growth, for the vast majority of our lower-wage workers, that would also set the tone and drive competition in terms of the labour market at that level, and perhaps for such merchants, when they need to retain or pay their workers better, I think this is where their workers, too, will start comparing benchmarks in other sectors which are paying far better.

sections.label: PWMs moving to gross wages
sections.summary: PWMs are moving to gross wages including overtime pay and allowances, targeting the bottom 20% of workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: In fact, moving forward, that is why we are also moving all our PWMs towards gross wages to include the full package, not just overtime pay but also allowances.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: We certainly want to ensure that we support our lower-wage workers well and really, these are the bottom 20%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, for example, if you have a worker earning, say, $2,400 base, but his overtime pay adds up to $3,500 or even $4,000, then that does not qualify him as a low-income technically, because the real income that he gets home is much more than what lower-wage workers are getting.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, our target is really the bottom 20%.

sections.label: Cliff edge for growing firms
sections.summary: There is concern that growing firms face a cliff edge effect in attaining C3 and C4 to reach 40 points.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: The concern here is, of course, that it creates potentially a cliff edge effect for firms that are growing, such that it will be trickier for them to attain C3 and C4 to get up to 40 points, in the event that they want to grow and become a medium-sized firm.

sections.label: Foundational criteria start date
sections.summary: Foundational criteria start on 1 September 2023, with schemes to support startups and SMEs in Singapore's business ecosystem.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As far as the foundational criteria is concerned, we are going to start this on 1 September 2023.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim, the reassurance that I want to give to all startups, all SMEs, is that we are trying our best to support our own Singapore business ecosystem.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We have the Singapore Global Enterprise Aspiration, earlier on, we have also shared the Enterprise 2030 vision and we do have multiple schemes available to support them.

sections.label: EP holders under new criteria
sections.summary: About 166,000 EP holders based on last year's data would not have been issued an EP under the new criteria.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Under the new qualifying criteria, how many EP holders today would not have been issued with an EP, under the new criteria?

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: So, today, we have got a fixed number.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I think it is about 166,000 based on last year's data.

sections.label: EP holder churn
sections.summary: Churn in EP holders, about 40,000 a year, is expected to cover any slack over the next four to five years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Suffice to say, from now till the next four to five years, when all the renewals of existing applications have been taken that into consideration, I think that the churn in EP holders would take care of whatever slack that exists together, even if the numbers do not meet the COMPASS framework that we put up today, the churn will take care of that.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: In terms of the perspective, today, on any given year, our churn in EP holders is about 40,000 a year.

sections.label: COMPASS application process
sections.summary: COMPASS will not make the application process more cumbersome or lengthier, as much required information is already collected upstream.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: COMPASS will not make the application process more cumbersome or lengthier.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Much of the information required is already collected upstream in our databases such as the firm's workforce profile.
